source.other: But let me first give you an overview about your territory: here in the south, you have a whole economy with almost everything you need.

target.other: Men låt mig först ge dig en översikt över ditt territorium: här i söder har du en komplett ekonomi med nästan allt du behöver.

key: But let me first give you an overview about your territory: here in the south, you have a whole economy with almost everything you need.

source.other: Here in the northern part, you only have a goldmine and a warehouse. While the miners are supplied well with food, there is no way to transport the gold ore to our smelting works in the southern part.

target.other: Här i den norra delen har du bara en guldgruva och ett magasin. Gruvarbetarna har god tillgång till mat, men det går inte att transportera guldmalmen till våra smältverk i den södra delen.

key: Here in the northern part, you only have a goldmine and a warehouse. While the miners are supplied well with food, there is no way to transport the gold ore to our smelting works in the southern part.

source.other: We have tried to build a road, but the mountain is too wide and too steep. We therefore have only one possibility: we need to establish a sea lane between these two parts.

target.other: Vi har försökt bygga en väg, men berget är för brett och för brant. Vi har därför bara en möjlighet: vi måste anlägga en farled mellan de två delarna.

key: We have tried to build a road, but the mountain is too wide and too steep. We therefore have only one possibility: we need to establish a sea lane between these two parts.

source.other: But I don’t want to rush you: you have just arrived here and you would probably like to have a closer look at your camp. I will also take a short break and be back soon.

target.other: Men jag vill inte skynda på dig: du har just anlänt och vill säkert titta närmare på ditt läger. Jag tar också en kort paus, men är snart tillbaka.

key: But I don’t want to rush you: you have just arrived here and you would probably like to have a closer look at your camp. I will also take a short break and be back soon.

source.other: For everything you do on the high seas, you need a port at the shore. Ports are like headquarters: they can store wares, workers and soldiers. The soldiers inside will automatically come out when an enemy attacks the port.

target.other: För allt du gör till havs behöver du en hamn vid kusten. Hamnar är som högkvarter: de kan lagra varor, arbetare och soldater. Soldaterna där inne kommer automatiskt ut när en fiende attackerar hamnen.

key: For everything you do on the high seas, you need a port at the shore. Ports are like headquarters: they can store wares, workers and soldiers. The soldiers inside will automatically come out when an enemy attacks the port.

source.other: Additionally, ports offer the possibility of transporting wares via ships. When you click on the port you already have, you will notice two additional tabs: ‘Wares waiting to be shipped’ and ‘workers waiting to embark.’ They are waiting for a ship to transport them to another port. Currently, there are none because we have not yet built a second port. So let’s change this!

target.other: Dessutom kan hamnar användas för att transportera varor med skepp. När du klickar på hamnen du redan har ser du två extra flikar: ”Varor som väntar på att skeppas” och ”Arbetare som väntar på att gå ombord”. De väntar på ett skepp som ska transportera dem till en annan hamn. Just nu finns det inga, eftersom vi ännu inte har byggt en andra hamn. Låt oss ändra på det!

key: Additionally, ports offer the possibility of transporting wares via ships. When you click on the port you already have, you will notice two additional tabs: ‘Wares waiting to be shipped’ and ‘workers waiting to embark.’ They are waiting for a ship to transport them to another port. Currently, there are none because we have not yet built a second port. So let’s change this!

source.other: Building ports

target.other: Bygg hamnar

key: Building ports

source.other: Ports are big buildings, but they can only be built at special locations: those marked with the

target.other: Hamnar är stora byggnader, men de kan bara byggas på särskilda platser: de som är markerade med den

key: Ports are big buildings, but they can only be built at special locations: those marked with the

source.other: blue port space icon.

target.other: blå hamnplatsikonen.

key: blue port space icon.

source.other: Port spaces are set by the map designer, so a map will either contain them or not. They might, however, be hidden under trees or be blocked by surrounding buildings.

target.other: Hamnplatser placeras ut av kartkonstruktören, så en karta kan antingen innehålla dem eller sakna dem. De kan dock vara dolda under träd eller blockerade av omkringliggande byggnader.

key: Port spaces are set by the map designer, so a map will either contain them or not. They might, however, be hidden under trees or be blocked by surrounding buildings.

source.other: Build a port next to your castle, on the blue port space icon.

target.other: Bygg en hamn bredvid ditt slott, på den blå hamnplatsikonen.

key: Build a port next to your castle, on the blue port space icon.

source.other: Ports are built like normal buildings, but are only available on blue port spaces. Just click on a field with the icon and the building menu automatically offers you to build a port.

target.other: Hamnar byggs som vanliga byggnader, men kan bara byggas på blå hamnplatser. Klicka på ett fält med ikonen, så erbjuder byggnadsmenyn automatiskt en hamn.

key: Ports are built like normal buildings, but are only available on blue port spaces. Just click on a field with the icon and the building menu automatically offers you to build a port.

source.other: Great. While your port is being constructed, let’s build some ships.

target.other: Bra. Medan din hamn byggs kan vi bygga några skepp.

key: Great. While your port is being constructed, let’s build some ships.

source.other: Ships are constructed at the coastline near a shipyard by a shipwright. We have to build one somewhere close to the shore.

target.other: Skepp byggs vid kusten nära ett skeppsvarv av en skeppsbyggare. Vi måste bygga ett någonstans nära kusten.

key: Ships are constructed at the coastline near a shipyard by a shipwright. We have to build one somewhere close to the shore.

source.other: Ships are produced by a shipyard. It is a medium building.

target.other: Skepp byggs vid ett skeppsvarv. Det är en mellanstor byggnad.

key: Ships are produced by a shipyard. It is a medium building.

source.other: The shipyard is a medium building. Although it can be built everywhere on the map, the shipwright only works when he is close to the water and there are no trees or roads at the shoreline.

target.other: Skeppsvarvet är en mellanstor byggnad. Även om det kan byggas var som helst på kartan arbetar skeppsbyggaren bara när han är nära vattnet och det inte finns några träd eller vägar vid stranden.

key: The shipyard is a medium building. Although it can be built everywhere on the map, the shipwright only works when he is close to the water and there are no trees or roads at the shoreline.

source.other: Very good. Your shipyard is finished and your shipwright immediately started working. For the construction of ships, he needs logs, planks and spidercloth, which will be transported to the shipyard.

target.other: Mycket bra. Ditt skeppsvarv är klart och din skeppsbyggare börjar genast arbeta. För att bygga skepp behöver han stockar, plankor och spindeltyg, som transporteras till skeppsvarvet.

key: Very good. Your shipyard is finished and your shipwright immediately started working. For the construction of ships, he needs logs, planks and spidercloth, which will be transported to the shipyard.

source.other: Construct two ships

target.other: Bygg två skepp

key: Construct two ships

source.other: Ships are constructed automatically when the shipyard is complete and the needed wares have been delivered.

target.other: Skepp byggs automatiskt när skeppsvarvet är klart och de varor som behövs har levererats.

key: Ships are constructed automatically when the shipyard is complete and the needed wares have been delivered.

source.other: Do not forget to stop your shipyard when you have enough ships.

target.other: Glöm inte att stoppa skeppsvarvet när du har tillräckligt många skepp.

key: Do not forget to stop your shipyard when you have enough ships.

source.other: Your second ship, "%1%", is ready now.

target.other: Ditt andra skepp, ”%1%”, är nu klart.

key: Your second ship, "%1%", is ready now.

source.other: You need to stop your shipyard when you have enough ships. Otherwise, your shipwright will consume all your logs and spidercloth, producing dozens of ships.

target.other: Du måste stoppa skeppsvarvet när du har tillräckligt många skepp. Annars förbrukar skeppsbyggaren alla dina stockar och allt ditt spindeltyg genom att bygga mängder av skepp.

key: You need to stop your shipyard when you have enough ships. Otherwise, your shipwright will consume all your logs and spidercloth, producing dozens of ships.

source.other: The second ship might not be finished yet, but we have an urgent problem.

target.other: Det andra skeppet kanske inte är klart än, men vi har ett akut problem.

key: The second ship might not be finished yet, but we have an urgent problem.

source.other: As you surely have already noticed, there is no iron in the mountain in the west. We have plenty of coal and gold ore, but without iron ore, we cannot produce any tools.

target.other: Som du säkert redan har sett finns det ingen järnmalm i berget i väster. Vi har gott om kol och guldmalm, men utan järnmalm kan vi inte tillverka några verktyg.

key: As you surely have already noticed, there is no iron in the mountain in the west. We have plenty of coal and gold ore, but without iron ore, we cannot produce any tools.

source.other: A trip by the sea, what fun it can be

target.other: En resa till sjöss, så roligt det kan vara

key: A trip by the sea, what fun it can be

source.other: During an expedition, you send a ship out to discover new islands and maybe found a colony there.

target.other: Under en expedition skickar du ut ett skepp för att utforska nya öar och kanske grunda en koloni där.

key: During an expedition, you send a ship out to discover new islands and maybe found a colony there.

source.other: Expeditions can be started in every port. Then, all needed wares are transported to that port. The wares are exactly those your tribe needs to build a port (your goal is to build a port far away from home, so this is not surprising), and of course you need a builder, too. When everything is prepared, a ship will come and pick it up.

target.other: Du kan starta expeditioner från vilken hamn som helst. Då transporteras alla nödvändiga varor dit. Det är just de varor som din klan behöver för att bygga en hamn. Eftersom målet är att bygga en hamn långt hemifrån är det inte så förvånande. Du behöver förstås också en byggare. När allt är förberett kommer ett skepp och hämtar varorna.

key: Expeditions can be started in every port. Then, all needed wares are transported to that port. The wares are exactly those your tribe needs to build a port (your goal is to build a port far away from home, so this is not surprising), and of course you need a builder, too. When everything is prepared, a ship will come and pick it up.

source.other: You can check out the needed wares in the Expedition tab of your port (it will appear in the last place when you’ve started an expedition).

target.other: Du kan se vilka varor som behövs på fliken Expedition i din hamn. Den visas längst till höger när du har startat en expedition.

key: You can check out the needed wares in the Expedition tab of your port (it will appear in the last place when you’ve started an expedition).

source.other: Now try this out. I will tell you later what the next steps are.

target.other: Prova det nu. Senare berättar jag vilka nästa steg är.

key: Now try this out. I will tell you later what the next steps are.

source.other: I packed my bag and in it I put …

target.other: Jag packade min väska och lade i den …

key: I packed my bag and in it I put …

source.other: Additional Items

target.other: Ytterligare enheter

key: Additional Items

source.other: You can take some additional wares, soldiers, or workers with you on an expedition. You can define them by filling the empty slots below the primary wares to build the port.

target.other: Du kan ta med ytterligare varor, soldater eller arbetare på en expedition. Välj dem genom att fylla de tomma fälten under varorna som behövs för att bygga hamnen.

key: You can take some additional wares, soldiers, or workers with you on an expedition. You can define them by filling the empty slots below the primary wares to build the port.

source.other: Just click on the empty slots and then scroll through the list to choose the additional item.

target.other: Klicka på de tomma fälten och bläddra sedan i listan för att välja en ytterligare enhet.

key: Just click on the empty slots and then scroll through the list to choose the additional item.

source.other: To do so, click on the ‘Start Expedition’ button in any port. A new tab where you can see the needed wares will appear.

target.other: Gör så här: klicka på knappen ”Starta expedition” i valfri hamn. En ny flik med de varor som behövs visas.

key: To do so, click on the ‘Start Expedition’ button in any port. A new tab where you can see the needed wares will appear.

source.other: Your expedition ship is ready. It is waiting for your orders in front of your port. It isn’t transporting wares anymore. Use its buttons to send your ship in any of the six main directions of the Widelands map. When it has reached a coastline, you can make it travel around the coast, where it will look for suitable places for landing.

target.other: Ditt expeditionsskepp är klart och väntar på dina order utanför din hamn. Det transporterar inte längre varor. Använd knapparna för att skicka skeppet i någon av Widelands sex huvudriktningar. När det har nått en kust kan du beordra det att segla längs kusten, där det letar efter lämpliga landstigningsplatser.

key: Your expedition ship is ready. It is waiting for your orders in front of your port. It isn’t transporting wares anymore. Use its buttons to send your ship in any of the six main directions of the Widelands map. When it has reached a coastline, you can make it travel around the coast, where it will look for suitable places for landing.

source.other: When you click on the expedition ship, a window opens where you can control your ship.

target.other: När du klickar på expeditionsskeppet öppnas ett fönster där du kan styra skeppet.

key: When you click on the expedition ship, a window opens where you can control your ship.

source.other: You’ve lead the expedition to a successful end and founded a new colony. I’ve sent out some geologists – they already report that they’ve found some iron ore.

target.other: Du har lett expeditionen till ett lyckat slut och grundat en ny koloni. Jag har skickat ut några geologer – de rapporterar redan att de har hittat järnmalm.

key: You’ve lead the expedition to a successful end and founded a new colony. I’ve sent out some geologists – they already report that they’ve found some iron ore.

source.other: To make sure they are properly defended, you can set the desired number of defending soldiers for both in the Soldiers tab, similar to military buildings. But they are also warehouses at the same time, so they can hold any number of soldiers. The desired number makes sure that defenders are requested by the port or headquarters, and once they are garrisoned there, they don't get sent away to serve other needs.

target.other: För att se till att de försvaras ordentligt kan du, precis som för militära byggnader, ange önskat antal försvarssoldater för båda på fliken Soldater. De fungerar dock också som lagerbyggnader och kan därför rymma valfritt antal soldater. Det önskade antalet gör att hamnen eller högkvarteret begär försvarare och att de, när de väl är stationerade där, inte skickas iväg för andra uppgifter.

key: To make sure they are properly defended, you can set the desired number of defending soldiers for both in the Soldiers tab, similar to military buildings. But they are also warehouses at the same time, so they can hold any number of soldiers. The desired number makes sure that defenders are requested by the port or headquarters, and once they are garrisoned there, they don't get sent away to serve other needs.

source.other: It will take some time for your shipyard to build some ships. While we’re waiting for them, there is another way of water-based transport I would like to teach you.

target.other: Det tar en stund för ditt skeppsvarv att bygga några skepp. Medan vi väntar på dem vill jag visa dig ett annat sätt att transportera varor på vatten.

key: It will take some time for your shipyard to build some ships. While we’re waiting for them, there is another way of water-based transport I would like to teach you.

source.other: Rowboats & Ferry Yards

target.other: Roddbåtar och färjevarv

key: Rowboats & Ferry Yards

source.other: This is where ferries come in. Ferries are small rowboats that can carry only one ware at a time, and no workers (other than the one who rows it and who never leaves his boat).

target.other: Här kommer färjorna in i bilden. Färjor är små roddbåtar som bara kan transportera en vara åt gången och inga arbetare, förutom den som ror båten och aldrig lämnar den.

key: This is where ferries come in. Ferries are small rowboats that can carry only one ware at a time, and no workers (other than the one who rows it and who never leaves his boat).

source.other: Ferries are built in ferry yards, one rowboat costs two logs and one piece of cloth and is quickly constructed. A ferry yard is a medium-sized building that needs to be built close to the shore.

target.other: Färjor byggs i färjevarv. En roddbåt kostar två stockar och ett tygstycke och byggs snabbt. Ett färjevarv är en mellanstor byggnad som måste byggas nära kusten.

key: Ferries are built in ferry yards, one rowboat costs two logs and one piece of cloth and is quickly constructed. A ferry yard is a medium-sized building that needs to be built close to the shore.

source.other: Let’s build a ferry yard close to the shore before we will continue.

target.other: Låt oss bygga ett färjevarv nära kusten innan vi fortsätter.

key: Let’s build a ferry yard close to the shore before we will continue.

source.other: Build a ferry yard

target.other: Bygg ett färjevarv

key: Build a ferry yard

source.other: Build a ferry yard close to the shore

target.other: Bygg ett färjevarv nära kusten

key: Build a ferry yard close to the shore

source.other: Ferries are constructed by a ferry yard.

target.other: Färjor byggs vid ett färjevarv.

key: Ferries are constructed by a ferry yard.

source.other: You need to build the ferry yard close to the shore, otherwise it won’t be able to build ferries there.

target.other: Du måste bygga färjevarvet nära kusten, annars kan det inte bygga färjor där.

key: You need to build the ferry yard close to the shore, otherwise it won’t be able to build ferries there.

source.other: Unlike ships which travel to any port where they’re needed, ferries have fixed transport routes called waterways. A waterway is built just like a road: You click on a flag near the shore, choose ‘Build a waterway’, and select the path for the waterway just as you would do for a road.

target.other: Till skillnad från skepp, som seglar till de hamnar där de behövs, har färjor fasta transportleder som kallas vattenvägar. En vattenväg byggs precis som en väg: du klickar på en flagga nära stranden, väljer ”Bygg en vattenväg” och väljer vattenvägens sträckning på samma sätt som för en väg.

key: Unlike ships which travel to any port where they’re needed, ferries have fixed transport routes called waterways. A waterway is built just like a road: You click on a flag near the shore, choose ‘Build a waterway’, and select the path for the waterway just as you would do for a road.

source.other: Waterways can be built on the open sea as well as close to the shore where the water is too shallow for big ships. The only rule is that the two triangles directly adjacent to each segment of the waterway have to be water, and the entire path needs to be within your territory.

target.other: Vattenvägar kan byggas både på öppet hav och nära kusten, där vattnet är för grunt för stora skepp. Den enda regeln är att de två trianglar som ligger direkt intill varje segment av vattenvägen måste vara vatten och att hela sträckan måste ligga inom ditt territorium.

key: Waterways can be built on the open sea as well as close to the shore where the water is too shallow for big ships. The only rule is that the two triangles directly adjacent to each segment of the waterway have to be water, and the entire path needs to be within your territory.

source.other: Also note that waterways, unlike roads, may not be built quite as long as you want them to. Every map has a length restriction for waterways. On this map, this is 5 tiles.

target.other: Observera också att vattenvägar, till skillnad från vägar, inte kan byggas hur långa som helst. Varje karta har en längdbegränsning för vattenvägar. På den här kartan är gränsen fem rutor.

key: Also note that waterways, unlike roads, may not be built quite as long as you want them to. Every map has a length restriction for waterways. On this map, this is 5 tiles.

source.other: Now it’s your turn: Build a gold mine on the mountain in the south and connect it to the main land by building waterways over the streams.

target.other: Nu är det din tur: bygg en guldgruva på berget i söder och anslut den till fastlandet genom att bygga vattenvägar över vattendragen.

key: Now it’s your turn: Build a gold mine on the mountain in the south and connect it to the main land by building waterways over the streams.

source.other: A waterway is built just like a road: You click on a flag near the shore, choose ‘Build a waterway’, and select the path for the waterway just as you would do for a road.

target.other: En vattenväg byggs precis som en väg: du klickar på en flagga nära stranden, väljer ”Bygg en vattenväg” och väljer vattenvägens sträckning på samma sätt som för en väg.

key: A waterway is built just like a road: You click on a flag near the shore, choose ‘Build a waterway’, and select the path for the waterway just as you would do for a road.

source.other: Now there are only a few more things I would like you to keep in mind whenever using ferries.

target.other: Nu återstår bara några saker som jag vill att du ska tänka på när du använder färjor.

key: Now there are only a few more things I would like you to keep in mind whenever using ferries.

source.other: Never forget that these rowboats are too small to carry workers. You can use them as shortcuts for ware transport within parts of your territory, but not to claim regions you can reach neither by road nor by ship. Never cut all your roads between two places connected by waterways unless you are certain no worker will ever have to walk there.

target.other: Glöm aldrig att dessa roddbåtar är för små för att transportera arbetare. Du kan använda dem som genvägar för varutransporter inom delar av ditt territorium, men inte för att göra anspråk på regioner som du inte kan nå vare sig på väg eller med skepp. Ta aldrig bort alla vägar mellan två platser som är förbundna med vattenvägar, om du inte är säker på att ingen arbetare någonsin behöver gå där.

key: Never forget that these rowboats are too small to carry workers. You can use them as shortcuts for ware transport within parts of your territory, but not to claim regions you can reach neither by road nor by ship. Never cut all your roads between two places connected by waterways unless you are certain no worker will ever have to walk there.

source.other: Ferry yard production

target.other: Färjevarvets produktion

key: Ferry yard production

source.other: As you can see, ferries can be produced quite quickly, but you don't need to worry about wasted materials, because ferry yards normally only produce them on demand, when there are unserviced waterways.

target.other: Som du ser kan färjor byggas ganska snabbt, men du behöver inte oroa dig för materialspill. Färjevarv bygger normalt bara färjor vid behov, när det finns vattenvägar utan färjetrafik.

key: As you can see, ferries can be produced quite quickly, but you don't need to worry about wasted materials, because ferry yards normally only produce them on demand, when there are unserviced waterways.
